headline: Strong inflows and steady fees despite choppy markets

kpis.label: GAAP net income attributable to Blackstone

summary_short: Blackstone reported distributable earnings of $1.7B ($1.32 per share) and fee related earnings of $1.6B, with inflows of $63B and total AUM at $1,368.3B.
summary_long: GAAP net income was $1.3B for the quarter, of which $662M was attributable to Blackstone shareholders. Fee-earning AUM reached $989.7B. Net accrued performance revenues fell to $7.3B ($5.84 per share) quarter over quarter as realized distributions rose across strategies. The firm declared a $1.12 quarterly dividend payable November 9. Management said flagship strategies outperformed public indices and highlighted AI and energy infrastructure platforms.
confidence_notes: The shard's EPS figure (1.32) is distributable earnings per share, a non-GAAP measure, not GAAP EPS; GAAP EPS was not read from the table. Revenue and DE y/y deltas are omitted because table column order was ambiguous in the extracted text. AUM y/y is computed from the release table's 3Q'25 value ($1,241.7B).

drivers.explanation: Inflows reached $63 billion with positive momentum across major fund-raising channels, per the chairman's comments.
Management says flagship strategies outperformed comparable public market indices amid a volatile external environment.
